name: 可用性（测试/评估/改进）流程

map.基于SUS系统可用性量表（10题）与任务绩效指标，综合评估产品可用性并给出改进建: Combines the standard 10-item SUS questionnaire with task-performance metrics — success rate, time, errors, help requests and satisfaction — to score usability and recommend fixes.
map.任务绩效分（0–100，五项加权）: Task performance score (0–100, five weighted items)
map.① 完成率得分 = min(成功任务数 ÷ 总任务数 × 100, 100)，权: ① Completion score = min(successful tasks ÷ total tasks × 100, 100), weight 0.35
map.② 时间得分 = max(100 − (平均用时 ÷ 预期用时 − 1) × 1: ② Time score = max(100 − (avg time ÷ expected time − 1) × 100, 0), weight 0.25 (time equals expected → 100; reaching 2× expected → 0)
map.③ 错误得分 = max(100 − (错误数 ÷ 总任务数) ÷ 3 × 10: ③ Error score = max(100 − (error count ÷ total tasks) ÷ 3 × 100, 0), weight 0.20
map.④ 求助得分 = max(100 − (求助次数 ÷ 总任务数) × 100,: ④ Help score = max(100 − (help count ÷ total tasks) × 100, 0), weight 0.10
map.⑤ 满意度得分 = (满意度 − 1) ÷ 6 × 100（1–7 量表线性映射: ⑤ Satisfaction score = (satisfaction − 1) ÷ 6 × 100 (1–7 scale linearly mapped to 0–100), weight 0.10
map.任务绩效分 = ①×0.35 + ②×0.25 + ③×0.20 + ④×0.1: Task performance score = ①×0.35 + ②×0.25 + ③×0.20 + ④×0.10 + ⑤×0.10
map.SUS 系统可用性量表（10 题，1–5 分）: SUS System Usability Scale (10 items, 1–5 points)
map.：奇数题（正面表述）计「选项值 − 1」，偶数题（负面表述）计「5 − 选项值」: : Odd items (positive wording) score "option − 1"; even items (negative wording) score "5 − option"; the ten items sum to 0–40,
map.换算成 0–100 分（SUS 标准换算系数，行业参考均值 68 分）。: then convert to 0–100 (SUS standard factor; industry reference mean is 68).
map.请根据用户测试反馈，对以下10个陈述打分（1=非常不同意，5=非常同意）: Based on user test feedback, rate the following 10 statements (1=strongly disagree, 5=strongly agree)
map.SUS（System Usability Scale）：标准10题量表，奇数题为: SUS (System Usability Scale): standard 10-item scale; odd items positive, even items negative
map.SUS评分：奇数题得分=选项-1，偶数题得分=5-选项，总分×2.5=最终SUS: SUS scoring: odd item score = option − 1, even item score = 5 − option; total × 2.5 = final SUS (0–100)
map.SUS平均分为68分，80分以上为A级（优秀），低于50分为不及格: SUS average is 68; ≥80 is grade A (excellent), below 50 is fail
map.任务完成率≥90%为优秀，70%-89%为良好，50%-69%为一般: Task completion rate ≥90% is excellent, 70%–89% good, 50%–69% average
map.建议至少5名用户参与测试，可发现约85%的可用性问题: Recommend at least 5 users for testing to find about 85% of usability issues
map.任务绩效评估：录入任务总数、成功数、平均耗时与预期耗时、错误数、求助数、满意度（: Task performance evaluation: enter total tasks, successes, average and expected time, errors, help count and satisfaction (1–7) to get completion rate, time/error/help scores and the overall task score.
map.SUS 系统可用性量表：10 道李克特（1–5）题自动按奇偶题正向/反向计分，乘: SUS System Usability Scale: 10 Likert (1–5) items auto-scored positive/negative by odd/even, × 2.5 for a 0–100 SUS, with grade thresholds A/A-/B+ etc.
map.综合可用性评分：任务绩效（权重 0.40）与 SUS（权重 0.60）加权合成总: Overall usability score: task performance (weight 0.40) and SUS (weight 0.60) weighted into a total, for comparing versions and reporting.
map.录入：任务 10、成功 9、平均耗时 4min、预期 3min、错误 2、求助: Input: 10 tasks, 9 successes, avg 4min, expected 3min, 2 errors, 1 help, 5 users, satisfaction 5 (1–7); SUS all 10 items = 4 → completion 90%, time ratio 1.33×→time score 66.67, errors 0.2/task→error score 93.33, help 0.1/task→help score 90.00, satisfaction 5→satisfaction score 66.67; task performance = 82.50; SUS total 20 (×2.5)=50.00 (grade D); overall usability = 82.50×0.40+50.00×0.60=63 (average usability).
map.SUS 行业平均约 68；≥80 为可接受（Acceptable），≥85 接近: SUS industry average is about 68; ≥80 acceptable, ≥85 near excellent. Below 68 means overall usability needs major improvement. This example's 63 is average; prioritise task completion rate and operation time first.
map.定量 SUS 通常 5–10 人即可看出趋势，但样本小、: For quantitative SUS, 5–10 people already show trends, but small samples have
map.宽；找关键流程问题用 5 人（Nielsen 经验可发现约 85% 可用性问题的: ; for key-flow issues use 5 people (Nielsen's experience finds about 85% of usability issues), for significant statistics use a larger sample.
map.可用性测试与评估工具，结合SUS系统可用性量表（标准10题问卷）与任务绩效指标（: The usability testing and evaluation tool combines the SUS System Usability Scale (standard 10-item questionnaire) with task-performance metrics (completion rate/time/errors/help/satisfaction), evaluating product usability per ISO 9241-11 and Nielsen's usability heuristics, outputting SUS grade and improvement suggestions.
map.可学习性与可用性子量表分离计算: Learnability and usability subscales computed separately
map.1.(+) 我认为我会经常使用这个系统: 1.(+) I think that I would like to use this system frequently
map.2.(-) 我发现这个系统过于复杂: 2.(-) I found the system unnecessarily complex
map.3.(+) 我认为系统很容易使用: 3.(+) I thought the system was easy to use
map.4.(-) 我觉得需要技术人员的帮助才能使用这个系统: 4.(-) I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system
map.5.(+) 系统的各种功能整合得很好: 5.(+) I found the various functions in this system were well integrated
map.6.(-) 系统中存在太多不一致的地方: 6.(-) I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system
map.7.(+) 我能想象大多数人都能很快学会使用这个系统: 7.(+) I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly
map.8.(-) 我发现系统使用起来很笨拙: 8.(-) I found the system very cumbersome to use
map.9.(+) 我对使用这个系统很有信心: 9.(+) I felt very confident using the system
map.10.(-) 我需要先学习很多东西才能使用这个系统: 10.(-) I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system
map.产品可用性较差，用户完成任务困难。需要重新设计关键流程后重测。: The product has poor usability and users struggle to complete tasks. Key flows need to be redesigned and retested.
map.• 任务完成率偏低（80%）：优化关键任务流程，减少步骤，提供明确引导: • Task completion rate is low (80%): optimize key task flows, reduce steps and give clear guidance
map.• 完成时间超出预期（1.3x）：精简操作步骤，优化高频路径，提供快捷方式: • Completion time exceeds expectations (1.3x): streamline the steps, optimize frequent paths and offer shortcuts
map.• SUS得分低于平均（50<68）：系统整体可用性需大幅改进，重点解决一致性和: • SUS score is below average (50 < 68): overall usability needs major improvement, focusing on consistency and complexity
map.参考标准：ISO 9241-11, SUS (Brooke, 1996), Ni: Reference standards: ISO 9241-11, SUS (Brooke, 1996), Nielsen usability heuristics | test users: 5
